item.title: India T20 World Cup 2026 squad announcement Live updates: Yashasvi Jaiswal, Sanju Samson to feature?
item.description: India T20 World 2026 squad announcement: The BCCI (Board of Control for Cricket in India) is all set to announce India's squad for the upcoming edition of the T20 World Cup 2026 that will begin in February 2026.

item.title: Khaleda Zia, ex-Bangladesh PM, 'more stable'; no deterioration in her health: Doctor
item.description: Zia was hospitalised on November 23 after her health deteriorated. On December 12, officials announcement that she was put on ventilator support and doctors are monitoring her situation regularly.

item.title: Air India Express removes pilot from duty after assault allegation by passenger at Delhi airport
item.description: Reacting to the allegations, Air India Express issued a statement expressing regret over the incident. The airline said the pilot involved was travelling as a passenger at the time.

item.description: The latest Garena Free Fire MAX redeem codes offer players free access to exclusive items like gun skins and pets. These upgrades can give gamers a competitive edge, helping them climb the ranks more effectively.

item.title: Bihar CM Nitish Kumar's mother-in-law passes away at 90 after prolonged illness
item.description: Chief Minister Nitish Kumar fulfilled his family obligations with quiet dignity, reaching Patna's Bans Ghat cremation ground to say a final goodbye to his mother-in-law. His son Nishant Kumar and Bihar minister Ashok Chaudhary joined him, their faces etched with evident sorrow.

item.title: CBSE CTET February Registration 2026 ends; over 25.3 lakh candidates applied
item.description: CBSE CTET February Registration 2026: During the last three days of application submission i.e. on December 16, 17 and 18, the number of candidates' registered was 1,93,182, 3,53,218 and 4,14,981 respectively, read the CBSE's post on X.

item.title: ISRO to launch AST SpaceMobile satellite via LVM3 rocket on Dec 24
item.description: The ISRO's LVM3-M6 mission carrying US-based firm AST SpaceMobile communication satellite is slated for a morning liftoff on December 24 from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre.

item.title: 2026 money horoscope: These 3 zodiac signs may attract wealth and stability
item.description: Astrology suggests 2026 could be financially rewarding for Taurus, Leo and Sagittarius, with career growth, investment returns and new income opportunities shaping the year.

item.title: iPhone 15 gets massive discount, now available for Rs 36,490: Where to buy
item.description: The iPhone 15 has hit a record-low price during Croma's year-end sale. With a variety of stacking discounts and offers, shoppers can now purchase the device for less than half of its debut retail price.

item.title: Shashi Tharoor voices alarm over Bangladesh violence, calls attack 'assault on freedom of press'
item.description: The Congress MP also reacted to the suspension of visa services at Indian Assistant High Commissions in Khulna and Rajshahi due to security concerns. He called it a major setback for ordinary people.
